title: River belief-CFR cross-seed stability curve audit
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: Across the immutable 128, 512, and 2,048 iteration snapshots, cross-seed root-strategy TV will decrease and greedy agreement will increase monotonically, distinguishing underconvergence from irreducible seed instability and justifying one deeper solver-dose control.
material_change: Hash-verify and reaggregate the completed solver JSONL at every geometric checkpoint; generate no new trajectories, traversals, or policy updates.
baseline: Final-only pooled TV 0.3976 and greedy agreement 0.3970 at 2,048 iterations, with regret proxy ratio 0.2263 versus 128.
notes: Scale gate: regret and pooled TV must improve monotonically at both geometric steps; pooled greedy agreement must be nondecreasing at both steps; no policy distillation from this audit.

result.summary: Hash-verified reaggregation of all 54 saved snapshots showed monotone pooled convergence: regret 116.69 to 61.02 to 26.41, cross-seed TV 0.4669 to 0.4601 to 0.3976, and greedy agreement 0.275 to 0.350 to 0.397 at 128/512/2,048 iterations. The matched-coverage 512-to-2,048 TV log-log slope was only -0.105, projecting TV about0.344 at8,192; two individual states did not yet improve locally.
result.conclusion: The solver is directionally converging but slowly and heterogeneously. Evidence justifies one full-breadth 8,192-iteration control, not target distillation or a direct jump to 32,768.
result.next_step: Reconstruct the immutable six public states and 48-hand ranges from hash-bound artifacts; rerun the same three solver seeds with exact 2,048 replication and extend to8,192 in independently durable per-cell outputs. Require exact 2,048 metric replay, aggregate TV/agreement improvement, and no state-level catastrophic reversal before any 32,768 scale.
